result.instructions: Tools for Sendbird, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sendbird data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run sendbird_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sendbird_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sendbird_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. sendbird_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sendbird_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users in the application. Supports filtering by activity, nickname, ids, and metadata. Platform API: GET /users. Returns { users[], next }.

token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's `next`.

active_mode.description: Filter by activation state. Default activated.

user_ids.description: Comma-separated user ids to fetch specific users.

metadatakey.description: Metadata key to filter on (pair with metadatavalues_in).

tools.name: sendbird_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Fetch a single user by user_id. Platform API: GET /users/{user_id}.

include_unread_count.description: Include the user's total unread message count.

custom_types.description: Comma-separated channel custom types to scope the unread count.

super_mode.description: Scope unread count by Supergroup vs. group channels.

tools.name: sendbird_list_group_channels
tools.title: List group channels
tools.description: List group channels in the application, with rich filtering (name, members, distinct/public/super mode). Platform API: GET /group_channels. Returns { channels[], next }.

token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's `next`.

show_member.description: Include the member list in each channel.

custom_types.description: Comma-separated channel custom types to filter on.

members_include_in.description: Comma-separated user ids; returns channels including any of them.

distinct_mode.description: Filter by distinct flag. Default all.

super_mode.description: Filter by Supergroup vs. group. Default all.

tools.name: sendbird_get_group_channel
tools.title: Get a group channel
tools.description: Fetch a single group channel by URL, optionally with members and receipts. Platform API: GET /group_channels/{channel_url}.

tools.name: sendbird_list_group_channel_members
tools.title: List group channel members
tools.description: List the members of a group channel. Platform API: GET /group_channels/{channel_url}/members. Returns { members[], next }.

token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's `next`.

operator_filter.description: Filter by operator status. Default all.

member_state_filter.description: Filter by invitation/join state (e.g. joined, invited, invited_by_friend).

tools.name: sendbird_list_group_channels_by_user
tools.title: List a user's group channels
tools.description: List the group channels a given user belongs to. Platform API: GET /users/{user_id}/my_group_channels. Returns { channels[], next }.

token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's `next`.

show_member.description: Include the member list in each channel.

custom_types.description: Comma-separated channel custom types to filter on.

distinct_mode.description: Filter by distinct flag. Default all.

hidden_mode.description: Filter by hidden state (e.g. unhidden_only, hidden_only, all).

tools.name: sendbird_list_open_channels
tools.title: List open channels
tools.description: List open (public, participant-based) channels. Platform API: GET /open_channels. Returns { channels[], next }.

token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's `next`.

custom_types.description: Comma-separated channel custom types to filter on.

tools.name: sendbird_get_open_channel
tools.title: Get an open channel
tools.description: Fetch a single open channel by URL. Platform API: GET /open_channels/{channel_url}.

tools.name: sendbird_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List messages in a channel, anchored at a timestamp or message id. Provide EITHER message_ts (unix ms) OR message_id. Platform API: GET /{channel_type}/{channel_url}/messages. Returns { messages[] }.

channel_type.description: Channel type: group_channels (member-based) or open_channels (public, participant-based).

message_ts.description: Anchor timestamp in unix milliseconds. Provide this OR message_id.

message_id.description: Anchor message id. Provide this OR message_ts.

prev_limit.description: Number of messages before the anchor, 0-200.

next_limit.description: Number of messages after the anchor, 0-200.

message_type.description: Filter by message type: MESG (text), FILE, or ADMM (admin).

user_ids.description: Comma-separated sender user ids to filter on.

custom_types.description: Comma-separated message custom types to filter on.

tools.name: sendbird_request
tools.title: Raw GET request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: issue a raw GET to any Chat Platform API v3 path not wrapped by a dedicated tool (e.g. /group_channels/{url}/messages/{id}, /report, /applications/settings_global). READ-ONLY — GET only. Platform API: GET {path}.

path.description: API path beginning with "/", relative to the /v3 base (e.g. "/users/alex%40x.com/blocked_users").

params.description: Optional JSON object (as a string) of query params, e.g. '{"limit":50}'.

tools.name: sendbird_send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description: MUTATES Sendbird data: sends a message into a channel as a user (MESG) or as an admin (ADMM). File/multipart messages are not supported. Platform API: POST /{channel_type}/{channel_url}/messages.

channel_type.description: Channel type: group_channels (member-based) or open_channels (public, participant-based).

message_type.description: MESG (user text, default) or ADMM (admin message, no sender).

user_id.description: Sender user id. REQUIRED when message_type is MESG.

custom_type.description: Custom type tag for the message.

data.description: Additional structured data as a string (often JSON).

mention_type.description: Mention scope: specific users or the whole channel.

is_silent.description: If true, does not update channel's last message / unread counts.

send_push.description: Whether to send push notifications. Default true.

tools.name: sendbird_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: MUTATES Sendbird data: creates a new user. Platform API: POST /users.

issue_access_token.description: If true, issues an access token for the user in the response.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata object stored on the user.

tools.name: sendbird_update_user
tools.title: Update a user
tools.description: MUTATES Sendbird data: partially updates a user's profile. Only provided fields change. Platform API: PUT /users/{user_id}.

issue_access_token.description: If true, issues a new access token for the user.

tools.name: sendbird_create_group_channel
tools.title: Create a group channel
tools.description: MUTATES Sendbird data: creates a group channel with the given members. Platform API: POST /group_channels.

user_ids.description: User ids to add as members of the new channel.

channel_url.description: Custom channel URL; auto-generated if omitted.

custom_type.description: Custom type tag for the channel.

is_distinct.description: If true, reuse an existing channel with the same members instead of creating a duplicate.

is_public.description: If true, the channel is public (joinable without invitation).

data.description: Additional structured data as a string (often JSON).
